title: Causally-anchored multi-omic deep learning recovers exercise-responsive and ageing-causal genes from human physical activity

evidence_spans.quote: This study combines causally-anchored multi-omic Mendelian Randomisation (MR) with graph-based deep learning
vigorous physical activity (VPA) in the UK Biobank as exposure
CpGs causal for ageing by epigenome-wide MR
the molecular mechanisms through which exercise exerts these effects in humans

scope_reviewer.uncertainty_reason: The abstract does not state that molecular layers were measured in the same participants or specimens.
scope_reviewer.concise_rationale: An empirical human multi-omics MR and graph-learning analysis links genomic evidence with methylation, expression, protein, and glycan layers; it analyzes exceptional longevity and ageing-related outcomes, but does not apply an intervention.

causal_design_reviewer.exposure_or_intervention: cis-MR genetic proxies for CTSF protein and expression
causal_design_reviewer.comparator: genetically predicted higher versus lower CTSF levels
causal_design_reviewer.estimand_or_contrast: causal association of CTSF with exceptional longevity
causal_design_reviewer.concise_rationale: The report applies cis-MR to CTSF protein/expression and exceptional longevity; colocalisation is supporting evidence.
